name: Feat of Resistance — "It gains protection" goes to the spell's target, not everything
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. "Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn." The protection parser's subject was the whole capture ("Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It"), which is no filter at all, so the grant was global. The subject is now the last sentence, and a pronoun there takes the target an earlier sentence named. Brave the Elements ("Choose a color. White creatures you control gain …") is the reverse case: it was a single-target effect and is now the global grant over white creatures it should be.
